subject: Vignette sprint: customer spotlights + legal signoff (Pioneer Retail)
messages:
From: Ava Miller <ava@pioneerretail.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: events@pioneerretail.com
Date: Thu, 25 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pioneer Retail vignette sprint + approvals

Hi Kimberly —

Thanks again for offering the vignette one-pagers for our retail summit (May 12). We want 3 short customer spotlights (60–90s each) to hand to attendees and to include as a leave-behind on our booth table. High level ask: can Redwood provide final art and speaker micro-scripts by April 5 so our legal team can review trademarks and partner quotes?

Quick details we need from you:
- Confirm we can use the Redwood logo and short product blurb (2 sentences)
- One customer quote per vignette (we can source if Redwood wants)
- Micro-script for demo handoff (30–45s)

We can fast-track our legal team if you send a trademark/usage checklist and the PDF mock. Would you prefer we treat this as a co-branded asset or Pioneer-owned with Redwood attribution?

Appreciate the quick turnaround — our go-to-market team is scheduling booth walkthroughs next week.

Best,
Ava
Ava Miller
Head of Events, Pioneer Retail
ava@pioneerretail.com

Attachments: (none)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Ava Miller <ava@pioneerretail.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 25 Mar 2027 10:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pioneer Retail vignette sprint + approvals

Thanks Ava — great to be working together on this. We can absolutely hit April 5 with a locked PDF and speaker micro-scripts. Proposed approach:

1) Redwood prepares 3 vignette one-pagers (co-branded) with: headline, 2-sentence product blurb, 1 customer quote, and a 30–45s demo handoff script.
2) We deliver PDFs + source Artboard (Illustrator/PDF) and a separate doc with logos + trademark usage notes for your legal.
3) Pioneer legal reviews and returns redlines by April 12 (we'll need approval sooner if you plan preproduction printing).

I've added Lauren to coordinate creative and Marissa for copy approval. Ben will own final art export.

Deliverables we plan to attach April 5: onepager_vignettes_v2.pdf (print-ready), speaker_script_v3.docx, trademark_clearance_request.pdf. Do you want bleed for printed 4x6 cards or full-bleed 5x7?

I'll start a short checklist and share a Drive folder.

—Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Field Marketing Manager, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai

Attachments: (none yet)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2027 08:31:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pioneer Retail vignette sprint + approvals

Quick internal note as I pull copy together:
- For the customer quote placeholders, recommend we mark them as [Customer quote — approval required] rather than inserting draft paraphrases. Pioneer may want to supply verbatim quotes to avoid misattribution.
- Micro-scripts: I'll draft two variants per vignette (concise and expanded) so the booth staff can choose based on walk-by vs scheduled mini-demo.
- Tone: keep it product-light, outcome-heavy (latency and cost per inference as bullets under the blurb).

Ben — can you confirm if we should build the one-pagers at 300dpi CMYK with die-cut safe margins? Pioneer asked about bleed; print vendor usually prefers 0.125in.

ETA: I can have copy drafts by end of day Mar 30.

—Marissa
Senior Marketing Writer, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Attachments: storyboard_notes.txt (stub)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pioneer Retail vignette sprint + approvals

All — printing specs confirmed. I'll produce three PDF mockups at 5x7 full-bleed with 0.125in bleed and export a 4x6 crop for table cards. Files will be CMYK, 300dpi.

One question for legal flow: do we need a signed logo usage addendum before exporting final art, or is Pioneer legal's approval of trademark_clearance_request.pdf sufficient? If Pioneer needs an addendum, we should route the DocuSign now.

I'll start templates and attach speaker_script_v3.docx in the April 5 package.

—Ben
Design Lead, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

Attachments: print_spec_sheet.pdf (stub)

From: Ava Miller <ava@pioneerretail.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: events@pioneerretail.com, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 17:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pioneer Retail vignette sprint + approvals

Kimberly/Team —

This looks great and thanks for the clear plan. Pioneer legal confirmed they can review the trademark_clearance_request.pdf as a first pass; a signed addendum isn't strictly required unless we use co-branded marks beyond the standard logo lockup. We'll aim to return approvals (or inline redlines) by Apr 9.

Please go ahead with 5x7 full-bleed export and include a 4x6 crop. For customer quotes: Pioneer will provide two final approved quotes by Apr 2 (we'll send verified attribution and photo release if needed).

We'll also attach the onsite AV contact and booth dimensions for your production brief in the drive link.

Looking forward to April 5 package.

Thanks,
Ava
Head of Events, Pioneer Retail
ava@pioneerretail.com

Attachments: (none)
